text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much! Thanks to you 
staying with me all the way till morning, 
I got to kick off a totally groovy 
birthday♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, glad to hear it! And thank you for 
letting me stay over on such an important 
day.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's house is always fun to visit. 
There are so many unique retro 
decorations, like that beaded curtain by 
the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really love that, don't you? 
Jingle-jangling it around like a little 
kid♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Maruzen. Were you really okay 
with just this?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just waking up together on their birthday 
morning, you know? Of course, I poured my 
whole heart into celebrating it with them.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ When I woke up, you two were 
still there... It made me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...On days like this, it makes me wish 
just a little that I lived in the dorms. 
Just a tiny bit, though!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Maruzen really is so cute."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm, alright! Decided. C.B., let's 
crash at your place tonight too."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't celebrated enough yet! 
Time for birthday overtime! What do you 
say, Maruzen?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's like a dream come true~! 
This time, let's dance the night away 
until morning♪
